description: Remove direct pandas use from external I/O and widgets, reconcile the four packaging surfaces and enforce the absence mechanically
dependency_semantics: Phase 7 and the zero-reference gate also require polars_container_20261026 AC8 (residual xarray migration). Implementation may proceed in parallel; the package-level no-pandas gate cannot pass before the container track lands, because ecosystem_integration imports voiage.schema and schema imports xarray.

authorization.scope: Planning registration only; implementation not authorised
authorization.source: Owner request of 26 October 2026 to plan a wholesale pandas-to-Polars shift in Voiage

gates.evidence: Residual pandas and xarray references outside voiage/ (tests, docs, scripts, workflows, overlays) are inventoried but unmigrated; the allow-list is unwritten.
The container track is unstarted, so the package-level no-pandas gate cannot currently pass.

On the baseline, pyproject.toml and conda-recipe/meta.yaml declare pandas>=1.3,<3.0 and xarray>=0.19,<2025.0 while tox.ini typecheck pins pandas>=3.0.3 and xarray>=2026.7.0. The reconciliation is unstarted.
